    Optimization Team

    The Optimization team works on models, methods, and applications of optimization. Areas of expertise are discrete optimization and stochastic optimization. Applications cover various fields: biodiversity, energy, risk, supply chain, sustainability, transportation.

    The team has strong experience in industrial collaborations and has established long-lasting relations with several leading companies in energy and transportation. News

    • We organized the ROADEF congress from 26 to 28 of February 2025
    • We organized theICSP congress from 28 of July to 1st August 2025
